tequila.definition: n. Mexican liquor made from fermented juices of an agave plant
tequila.translation: n. 蒸馏酒, 龙舌兰酒

tequila sunrise.translation: 龙舌兰日出（用龙舌兰酒和橙汁、石榴汁调制而成的鸡尾酒）
